in_marathi.name: Sharvithan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Wisdom
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sharvithan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। God who bestows wisdom and knowledge, Sharva is a form of Lord Shiva, the god of wisdom and knowledge in Hinduism. The name Sharvithan is derived from Sharva, and it is a name that signifies the possessor of divine wisdom.

in_bengali.name: Sharvithan
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God of Wisdom
in_bengali.long_meaning: Sharvithan একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। God who bestows wisdom and knowledge, Sharva is a form of Lord Shiva, the god of wisdom and knowledge in Hinduism. The name Sharvithan is derived from Sharva, and it is a name that signifies the possessor of divine wisdom.
